name: sistema-padrao
description: SaaS multi-tenant de gestão de varejo — monorepo (core, api, web)

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @saas/api && npm run build -w @saas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @saas/core && npm run typecheck -w @saas/api && npm run typecheck -w @saas/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm test -w @saas/core && npm test -w @saas/api && npm test -w @saas/web
